name: Complete Test Recipe
author: Test Chef
description: A complete recipe with all fields populated
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened.
Pour in tomatoes and add paprika.
Simmer for 20 minutes until sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
